providers.reason: SentinelOne is a primary beneficiary of the 'Black October' cybersecurity emergency. Massive critical PHP vulnerabilities affecting 70% of websites have triggered a frantic global response, favoring SentinelOne's autonomous AI security platform. Recent analyst upgrades and its new 'Purple AI' monetization model provide additional technical and fundamental momentum.
providers.risk: Inherent high volatility and potential dilution concerns from the recent $1.25 billion convertible note offering.

providers.reason: Momentum is confirmed: shares closed 6.25% higher at $25.50 on 12.5M shares, above their 50- and 200-day averages and near a 52-week high, with RSI only about 60. Recent Buy reiterations from Oppenheimer and Rosenblatt support sentiment.
providers.risk: A failed breakout near $26.50 could unwind quickly; the unprofitable, high-multiple name has no company catalyst this week and is exposed to a tech risk-off tape.

providers.reason: Technical breakout above $25 resistance confirmed with four consecutive closes. Strong Buy signals on all moving averages, up 6.25% today. IDC MarketScape Leader recognition supports momentum.
providers.risk: No specific catalyst in 2-5 day window. FBN Securities downgrade and valuation concerns persist. Still 13% below October high, suggesting limited upside from current levels.
